title: P2: clear_child_record must remove by (pid, start_token), not whole-key (M0-T053 G5 finding 5)
objective: QUALIFYING EVIDENCE (AD-093 demonstrated security risk): M0-T053 G5 finding 5 + M0-T036-ACTIVATION-CHECKLIST P2. recovery.py:190-191 clear_child_record wipes the WHOLE CHILD_PROCESSES_KEY, so settle clears records it did not create. Latent today (exactly one recorder), but the moment M0-T056's successor-launch seam records anything, a worker's clean exit ERASES the live successor's record - fail-open on the no-duplicate-workers invariant D-010-R347 makes binding. SCOPE (smallest durable set): clear_child_record removes ONLY the entry matching (pid, start_token), leaving other recorded children intact; update its sole caller _settle_worker_record (claude_runner.py) to pass the pid+start_token it settled. Correct nothing else (supervisor-freeze). REQUIRED TESTS: settling one child leaves a second recorded child intact; settling a pid that is not recorded is a no-op; reused-pid with a different start_token is NOT cleared; full supervisor suite re-establishes the M0-T039 baseline (>=1165, 0 failures) plus the new tests.
business_reason: P2 is a required pre-M0-T056 correction: it removes the fail-open that appears the moment a second spawner (M0-T056 successor-launch) records a child, protecting the no-duplicate-workers invariant R347.
forbidden_paths: tools/agent_supervisor/** modules not named in allowed_paths (smallest durable set only; wider need = STOP-and-report at G0)
Any redesign or speculative supervisor feature (supervisor-freeze; defect-only)
acceptance_scenarios: P2-SC1 settling one child leaves a second recorded child intact (no whole-key wipe).
P2-SC2 settling a pid that is not recorded is a no-op (other records untouched).
P2-SC3 a reused pid with a DIFFERENT start_token is NOT cleared (start_token disambiguates).
P2-SC4 freeze baseline: full supervisor suite re-establishes M0-T039 (>=1165, 0 failures) + new tests; non-vacuity shown.
risks: Depends on M0-T058 (P1): both edit claude_runner.py — build AFTER P1 lands, branch off P1's claude_runner.py; never parallel producers.
Supervisor-freeze: change the tree hash, re-establish the M0-T039 baseline under G0/G2/G3/G5.
clear_child_record signature change ripples to its sole caller _settle_worker_record; keep the change minimal.

progress_log.message: Scope-wall resolution (orchestrator-authorized): the clear_child_record(journal,*,pid,start_token) signature change necessarily breaks the 1-arg monkeypatch spy in tools/test_agent_supervisor_start_reentry.py (a direct dependent of the changed fn, not in the 20-module freeze list but in the full-pytest CI job). Producer STOP-and-reported at the boundary (correct). Added that one test file to allowed_paths for the minimal 2-line companion fix (spy accepts+forwards **kwargs); no production behavior widened.
